name: Seth
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: Seth was appointed another seed instead of Abel. Through Seth men began to call upon the name of the Lord; they started to worship the Most High and keep the commandments, while the line of Cain went on in evil and wickedness. That is why the Most High chose the line of Seth.

note.label: Genesis 4: Cain, Abel, and the Sons of the Wicked

points: “And Adam knew his wife again”. While this is happening, Adam knew his wife again. The Cainites already had weapons, ruling, dominion; Cain already had his kids, built the city in Nod, got weapons. Then Adam lays with Eve again, “and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed”.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Seth replaced Abel and became the chosen line. Then began men to call upon the name of the Lord: because this was the lineage of the sons of God.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: “And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.” Stop: then began. So what was happening before that? Evil was everywhere and Cain was running it. When evil was ruling, God sent forth Seth, then he had his son Enos. Wickedness spread so much that men stopped calling on the name of the Lord, but when Seth and Enos were born, men began to call upon the name of the Lord.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Notice Seth was in Adam's likeness, after Adam's image. It did not say that about Cain; it said Cain was of that wicked one. Cain was in the image of Satan, not in the image of Adam.

“And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth”. Stop: why is it saying that Adam begat a son in his own likeness and in his own image? It doesn’t say that about Abel.

Adam had that understanding from the creation, when God gave it to him, and for the righteous seed to come down it had to come through Seth. Seth came out righteous. Seth came out as the man that Adam once was before his fall. Adam went off, but Seth came out in the manner in which Adam was before his fall. Seth is the righteous.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: “And he begat sons and daughters”. Adam had sons and daughters after this, but the main important one was Seth. The Lord said, I’m dealing with Seth here.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: He shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth: anybody that worships the Egyptian god Seth. And Edom shall be a possession: Edom shall become servants to this people, and Israel shall do valiantly.

And shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth. Balaam is prophesying of the latter days: this teaching identifies Moab with the Chinese and Ammon with the Japanese, and Sheth goes into the Egyptian. Asia is partaker of the hope of Babylon, going through the earth buying up land, trying to become financially what America already is and to deal with all nations as she has.

note.label: Numbers 24: A Star out of Jacob and the Latter Days

points: Adam was called the son of God, and in his lineage through Seth were also the sons of God, not Cain.
